summary: A leader brings draft amendments to lunch and hears objections from both wings of the party.
realLife: Dirksen brought forty amendments to a Republican luncheon. Conservatives distrusted the negotiations and liberals feared losing protections.
gates: The caucus is meeting on a negotiated draft.
inGame: needs: a caucus meeting linked to particular amendments and member objections.

turns.what: Members agree on the drafting changes and take the contested provisions home.
turns.pulledBy: The text corrections are clear but members have only just seen the policy changes.
turns.writesBack: The caucus records agreement on the corrections alone.

turns.what: The leader brings the amendments back at the next lunch.
turns.pulledBy: Several members asked to read the text alongside the existing bill.
turns.writesBack: The second meeting takes up the marked copies.
